limitations: Preview only: no normalized changes, applied evidence, or canonical review increment.
Two papers, four formulations; carbon source dose and batch/chemostat stage must not be conflated.
Twenty-six mineral amounts have an explicit water-input/final-volume boundary; two molybdate claims have a printed formula conflict.
Seven vitamin amounts per record are final concentrations; both papers directly report para-aminobenzoic acid 0.2 mg/L, not the database 0.1458 mM assertion.
The omitted silicone antifoam is 0.025 mL per liter of medium in 1992; 0.05 mL per liter water input in 1996. No density or final-volume conversion is inferred.
Existing ethanol parent/child notes saying only ethanol differs must be qualified when source antifoam and experimental-stage evidence is applied.
Paper-specific benzoate treatments are not a fixed universal basal ingredient dose.
DOI identity checked against PubMed; DOI resolver web attempts failed. Downloaded repository PDFs and page images provide the inspected concentration evidence.
No automatic reference-validator pass, numeric equivalence of old conversions, exhaustive growth review, or new organism association is asserted.
preview_corrections: Ten proposed amounts and four held input-amount transcriptions preserve the 1996 source trailing decimal zero; source values and statuses otherwise unchanged.
